$comment: D4 lifecycle scenarios: disconnect, freeze, grace, reload.

scenarios.title: Absent racer freezes at last valid state; race timer continues

notes: neutralize immediately when known; watchdog neutralizes after 250ms otherwise
remaining riders continue; elapsed race time keeps running

scenarios.title: Reconnect within grace rotates the lease and restores frozen state with elapsed time

notes: reconnect revalidates identity/room but does not demand the pre-anchor pose
airborne freeze resumes that state without an elapsed-time ballistic jump
old inputs from before the drop are never replayed

scenarios.title: Grace expiry marks DNF once with reason disconnect; admission may release

notes: slot stays in immutable current standings
cannot re-enter the current race; may queue for the next

scenarios.title: Reload keeps server grace; client offers resume only if the slot is still valid

notes: sessionStorage hint carries ONLY the activity id, never credentials or lease
after room acceptance the client asks to resume; a stale slot falls back to ordinary lobby/queue
reload after grace/deadline cannot resume the completed race but can queue

scenarios.title: Connected input starvation uses neutral braking; known disconnect freezes

notes: starvation is NOT a disconnect: motion continues under neutral braking
frozen riders integrate no motion at all
